name: Marcus Handlers
source:
Faction:	Terran
Birthday:	Unknown
Place of Birth:	Unknown
Occupation:	Chief Executive Officer
Affiliation:	Sigil Corporation
Voice Actor:	DraconisMarch

Profile:
Marcus Handlers is the current head of Earth’s foremost transnational conglomerate, the Sigil Corporation. After negotiations personally spearheaded by himself with the people of Mars failed, he has continuously supported the UTV by providing them the advanced units such as the Sierra, Blitzkrieg and the Lapis Units.

His connections are vast, and reach the highest echelons  of the military and the government.
